instructions: Inspect and modify workspace files with list, read, write and edit. Examples: {"action":"list","path":"."}, {"action":"read","path":"notes.txt"}, {"action":"write","path":"notes.txt","content":"new text"}. Read is paginated: follow next_offset when truncated. Use edit with byte start/end and expected_sha256 from a fresh read. Only enabled actions are available; writes and edits require the host approval policy. Paths are workspace-relative and confined to the workspace. list accepts cursor and limit; follow next_cursor. read offset/limit and edit start/end count bytes; edits require UTF-8 character boundaries. content_base64 is authoritative when present. write atomically replaces the whole file; edit atomically replaces [start,end) only if expected_sha256 still matches.
